settings.image_alt: Clara Wynn sitting in a sunny room
settings.name: Hello, I'm Clara
settings.bio:
I spent ten years as an editor at a busy newsroom, where the most important work always happened before nine in the morning, while the building was still quiet.

When I left, I wanted to keep that hour. The Quiet Hour is what I learned from trying, failing and trying again, written for people with full days and families and too many tabs open.

I live in Edinburgh, write in the mornings and send a short letter every other Sunday.

settings.name: Small books, written slowly
settings.bio: Every book starts as a letter to one reader. I test each chapter on twenty of them before it goes out, and I keep the books short on purpose: you should be able to finish one in a weekend and use it for years.
